name: dsh-lmstudio-long-prefill
description: Fixes the 5-min undici headersTimeout abort for local OpenAI-compatible providers (LM Studio, vLLM, etc.) by rewriting the OpenAI SDK's getDefaultFetch to use node:http (no timeout) for local routes. The plugin SELF-HEALS the SDK patch on every load (idempotent), so an npm upgrade that overwrites the openai package is re-patched on the next DSH start; it also installs a global-fetch fallback as belt-and-suspenders.
